# ssERP (Super Simple ERP)

> Open-source ERP, inventory and billing that tracks every unit by serial number / IMEI, from the vendor's invoice to the customer, warranty and service. Next.js 16, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL (Neon recommended). MIT licensed. Alpha (v0.1.x).

ssERP is built for shops that sell serialised goods (phones, CCTV, laptops, appliances). Key idea: one `product_units` row per physical unit with an append-only event history; stock is the count of in-stock units, never a hand-edited number. Money is exact (integer minor units, `numeric(14,2)`), every query is scoped by company (and branch), and a permission is checked before any input is read.

## Code map

- [src/server/serials.ts](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/blob/main/src/server/serials.ts): unit state machine (only place that changes unit status)
- [src/server/sales](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/tree/main/src/server/sales) and [purchases](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/tree/main/src/server/purchases): document creation with serial intake/scan-to-sell, returns, payments
- [src/server/lookup](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/tree/main/src/server/lookup): serial lookup and unit history
- [src/server/db/schema](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/tree/main/src/server/db/schema): Drizzle schema (migrations in /drizzle, append-only)
- [src/server/rbac.ts](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/blob/main/src/server/rbac.ts): permission catalog and default roles
- [src/server/money.ts](https://github.com/bemoshiur/Super-Simple-ERP-ssERP/blob/main/src/server/money.ts): exact money handling (supports Bangladeshi lakh grouping like 1,00,000)
